What is it?
It’s a presale for the limited-edition Set 1 Trencher collectible trading card packs. Physical trading cards. Enter the trenches and build your crew!
When is it?
Presale is August 12. Mint phases will be announced a few days before the presale.
How can I get WL?
You must hold at least 1 Trencher avatar NFT and all of the Trencher avatar NFTs in your wallet must be delisted. The presale is FCFS. 
What is the supply?
There are 500 total packs, with 5 cards per pack, equaling 2500 total cards.
How many packs can I purchase? What is the price?
5 packs max per wallet. Each pack costs $15
What is included in each pack? 
Each booster pack includes 5 cards. Cards in packs are randomized with varying rarities. Specific cards are not guaranteed. 
What are the rarity tiers and odds of pulling a specific card?
Common - 40%
Uncommon - 24%
Rare - 18%
Epic - 10%
Legendary - 6% 
Mythic - 2% 
How many cards are in the complete set?
There are 35 unique designs in this first set. 
Can I resell my packs?
Yes. Packs can be listed immediately on dyli's secondary marketplace and can continue to be bought, sold, or traded without being physically shipped until the current owner chooses to redeem them.
Can I open my pack through a live rip?
